original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. Mending.batch selects the head candidate of each eligible, distinct theorem or lemma declaration: the earliest open site of the declaration, in a body region, with no D12 combined candidate. Mending.batch_distinct and Mending.batch_bodyOnly hold, and no LeanMend constant depends on sorryAx. The Core has no stepBatch. Decisions P1, P2, P6 and P7 and the S2a acceptance check of docs/parallel.md hold.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. integrated has no Mending.batch. The branch worker/lea-fc0 (commit 6f9984c) has Mending.batch with batch_distinct and batch_bodyOnly proved. It also has Mending.stepBatch and Mending.stepBatch_measure, whose proof is sorry.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Run lake test: tests/OpsTest.lean shows Mending.batch on a module state with three failing theorem bodies, one failing def body, a second open site in one of the theorems, and one D12 combined candidate. The batch holds the earliest site of each theorem that has no D12 candidate, and it holds no def site. Run scripts/gate.sh: stdout is one JSON object, and failed is 0.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. Spec and Core import no Shell module (scripts/gate.sh checks it). Termination stays a theorem in LeanMend/Spec/Termination.lean, with no retry cap and no timeout as a control. Decision D10 holds: lean-mend adds no declaration to a target. lean-mend depends on Lean core only, not on Mathlib. Every committed text is in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Run export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH" before a lean or lake command. Scratch files go in the gitignored .scratch/ directory, not /tmp. The worker task timeout is 3600 seconds. Do not run lean-mend on EVMLean: one EVMLean run takes about 3 hours, and the operator runs it after the merge.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) LeanMend/Core/Mend.lean, tests/OpsTest.lean
restatement: Slice S2a of docs/parallel.md adds the prefetch selection to the Core, and nothing more. LeanMend/Core/Mend.lean gets a pure function Mending.batch. For a module state, it selects the head candidate of each eligible, distinct theorem or lemma declaration. The head candidate is the earliest open site of that declaration, in a body region, when the declaration has no D12 combined candidate. This implements decisions P1 (at most one candidate per theorem or lemma body), P2 (only theorem or lemma body regions), P6 (only the earliest site of a declaration with more than one open error) and P7 (no D12 combined candidate). Two theorems, Mending.batch_distinct and Mending.batch_bodyOnly, prove the selection properties, and no LeanMend constant depends on sorryAx. The slice takes the selection and its two proofs from worker/lea-fc0 (commit 6f9984c), but it does not take Mending.stepBatch or its false, sorry-proved stepBatch_measure. tests/OpsTest.lean shows Mending.batch on a module state with three failing theorem bodies, one failing def body, a second open site in one of the theorems, and one D12 combined candidate. The batch holds the earliest site of each theorem that has no D12 candidate, and it holds no def site. The full commit gate scripts/gate.sh passes. Spec and Core import no Shell module, and the Core does not use Mathlib.
